unit: Approval Gate idempotency checks vs pre-F-02 Communications rows
description: No approval that is still PENDING has its prior Communications activity recorded under an old 8-character delivery key.
why_it_exists: This is the exact cross-check the census was built to run. A PENDING approval whose earlier attempt was written under the old key format will, on decision, derive a 16-character key that matches nothing - so the gate's duplicate, pending and uncertain checks all look at an empty result set and the send proceeds as if it had never been attempted. The one-time append effect is harmless on decided approvals and dangerous on undecided ones.

expect.cross_check: collect approval_id from every Communications row whose idempotency_key matches ^SND-[0-9a-f]{8}(\|DRY)?$; intersect with the approval_id of every Approvals row whose status is PENDING; the intersection must be empty.

assertions: The set of approval_ids appearing on old-8-char-key Communications rows and the set of PENDING approval_ids do not intersect.
Every Actions row with status AWAITING_APPROVAL is reported alongside its action_id, matter_id, draft_id and approval_id so an orphaned approval can be traced.

If the intersection is non-empty, the correct remedy is a human decision about the affected approval, not a key rewrite - rewriting a stored key would break the collision detection in check 7d, which relies on the key's own pre-image.
target_unresolved_reason: kind is "invariant": not executed by harness/run.js.
